business_scope.primary_industry_name: Financial Market News Aggregation and Syndication Feed

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (unitary national jurisdiction; no corporate tax sub-jurisdictions)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law — continental codification (Código de Comercio and Civil Code), with corporate and trust statutes historically modeled on US (Delaware) practice; unitary national legislative competence without provincial tax divisions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Bilateral Investment Treaty with the Netherlands
Bilateral Investment Treaty with the United Kingdom
Bilateral Investment Treaty with Germany (in force 1985)
Free Trade Agreements with Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Peru (investment chapters)
Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements in force with Mexico, South Korea, UAE, Qatar, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Spain, and the United Kingdom

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: AML/CFT: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015, as amended by Ley No. 70 de 30 de enero de 2019 and Ley No. 254 de 30 de julio de 2021, together with resolutions of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF). Beneficial ownership: Ley No. 52 de 27 de octubre de 2016 (private beneficial-owner and share registers), regulated by UAF Reglamento No. 1 de 3 de mayo de 2023 governing the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (RBF). Corporations: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (General Law on Corporations); bearer shares immobilized and subject to mandatory conversion to nominative shares under Ley No. 23 de 2015.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the document holder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Panama acceded to the 1961 Apostille Convention, effective 1991) or Consular Legalization for non-Contracting States

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incumbency of the foreign corporate shareholder (where applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation (e.g., Delaware Secretary of State, UK Companies House)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (non-Contracting States)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney executed abroad for representation of shareholders and opening of the corporate files
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or equivalent legalization authority in the grantor's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (non-Contracting States)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation/transliteration of all apostilled documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified public translator (traductor público autorizado) or licensed counsel admitted before Panamanian courts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization of the translation (underlying document retains its apostille)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for payment-rail onboarding (SWIFT wire and Stripe)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding institution of the shareholder or of the company post-registration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy; apostille not required where the bank is verified electronically

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Pacto Social (Articles of Incorporation) engrossment in Spanish
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization; filed at the Registro Público de Panamá — no apostille required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based due diligence under Ley 23 de 2015 and UAF rules: (i) verification of UBOs through the RBF registry and statutory share registers; (ii) automated screening of shareholders, directors, UBOs, and counterparties against OFAC SDN/Non-SDN, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions, and the UAF national designated-persons list; (iii) PEP classification covering prominent public functions, immediate family members, and close associates, requiring enhanced due diligence and senior management approval; (iv) continuous transaction monitoring for SWIFT/wire and Stripe rails with STR/SAR filing to the UAF by the resident agent's designated compliance officer; (v) the Low_Risk_Standard tier does not exempt the client from the complete CDD file, source-of-funds statements, or record-retention obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sede Electrónica del Registro Público de Panamá (www.registro-publico.gob.pa) — corporate-services module ('Vista de Nombre' / 'Certificado de No Objeción'), normally filed by a licensed resident agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Spanish or in any Latin-alphabet language and must include the legal-form suffix 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.'. Non-Latin scripts (Han, Cyrillic, Arabic, etc.) are inadmissible unless transliterated into Latin characters by a certified translator and accompanied by the foreign-word rendition; names must be distinguishable from every registered or reserved name in the same category, and any foreign-language generic element must carry an accurate Spanish equivalent in the deed.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Financiera, Crédito, Leasing, Arrendamiento Financiero (when implying banking or lending) — prior authorization of the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá required
Seguros, Reaseguros, Fianzas, Aseguradora, Corredor de Seguros — prior authorization of the Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros
Casa de Valores, Bolsa de Valores, Fondo de Inversión, Administración de Fondos, Agente de Inversión — prior authorization of the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores
Trust, Fiduciaria, Fideicomiso — fiduciary license under the banking/financial-entity regime required
Casino, Juego, Apuestas, Lotería — prior gaming authorization under national and municipal gaming law

Ministerio, Gobierno, Presidencia, República, Nacional de Panamá, Canal de Panamá, Zona Libre de Colón — ministerial or institutional authorization required; marks suggesting state sponsorship are rejected
Criptomoneda, Crypto, Virtual Asset (VASP-type terms implying exchange/wallet activity) — prior digital-asset service-provider registration required
ONU, OEA, Banco Mundial, Cruz Roja, Unicef and other international-organization or sovereign emblems — absolutely prohibited
LLC, Ltd., GmbH, Corp. (used for a Panamanian S.A.) — incompatible suffixes; only 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.' is permissible
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The Vista de Nombre is valid for 30 calendar days and may be renewed once for a further 30 days against the public tariffs of the Registro Público; if the incorporation deed is not filed within the (extended) window, the name reverts to open availability. Upon rejection, the Registry issues a written denial stating the conflicting name or prohibited token. Within five business days the resident agent may file a written recurso de reconsideración with the Registro General; if denied, a recurso de apelación lies within five business days to the Director General of the Registro Público. A final contested decision is reviewable through acción contencioso-administrativa before the Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia within two months. Parallel expediting: filing a new name request is often faster and cheaper than exhausting the administrative appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: The statutory registered office must be a physical Panamanian address maintained by the licensed resident agent; a pure virtual office, coworking mailbox, or commercial agent address cannot satisfy this statutory mandate. For the financial-news-wire API activity (no statutory license required), a virtual address is permissible only for commercial correspondence and operational mail, provided the company maintains records manifesting the place and substance of its management, board decisions, and contract execution in support of the territorial tax filing; the resident agent remains responsible for the statutory seat.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — below 5% annualized probability for a standard-risk S.A. serviced by a licensed resident agent. The UAF and the Superintendencia supervise the resident agent as the regulated non-financial entity and inspect its records rather than client premises; an unannounced on-site inspection of the registered agent's address occurs principally upon adverse media, a sanctions match, or a correspondent-bank termination event. Inspection risk rises if the company books income from Panamanian-source activities without substance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Resident agent and registered office — first annual fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified copy / Folio Real certificate after registration and certified good-standing follow-up

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (Panama General Corporation Law), Law 32 of 1927, as amended by Law 1 of 2007, Law 3 of 2014 and Law 15 of 2018; Articles governing formation by public deed, capital stock, registered office, resident agent, board of directors, and corporate records.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama), Sección de Sociedades Mercantiles
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución / Pacto Social y Estatutos (Public Deed of Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for Sociedad Anónima. The Articles must state authorized capital, commonly US$10,000, and may provide for shares without nominal value. Shares may be issued for consideration determined by the board; there is no escrow account or deposit requirement at incorporation. Paid-in capital may be zero until shares are subscribed and paid.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, at the constitutive meeting of the board of directors held in Panama City on [date]: 1. The subscriptions to the authorized capital are accepted; the founders' shares are allotted and recorded in the shareholders ledger. 2. The registered office is fixed at [address], Corregimiento de San Francisco, Panama City, Republic of Panama, from which the company's legal records and statutory books shall be maintained. 3. The following officers are appointed for the first fiscal period: President, Secretary, and Treasurer, with full authority to sign and attest corporate documents. 4. The officers may open bank accounts, execute the online newswire commercial agreements, and complete all regulatory filings on behalf of the corporation. Approved unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Denominaciones; accessible via Panama Emprende single-window electronic portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the Panama Emprende portal or the Public Registry's Denominations office; submit the Solicitud de Nombre requesting approval and reservation of the proposed company name. The system scans existing corporate registries to ensure distinctness. Once approved, the name is reserved for 30 business days. Proceed to the next step only after receiving the name reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Completed name request form (Solicitud de Nombre)
Passport or cédula copy of the incorporator
Proposed corporate name and up to three alternatives
Payment receipt for name search fee (US$20)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected for similarity, resubmit with alternatives through the same portal. A formal reconsideration may be filed, but the practical cure is immediate selection of an alternative name without additional parental case processing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panamanian Notary Public (Notario Público) in the First Judicial Circuit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Panamanian attorney to draft the Pacto Social y Estatutos (Articles of Incorporation) in Spanish. The incorporator(s) appear before the notary to execute the public instrument. The instrument must contain the corporate name, duration, purpose, registered office address, resident agent appointment, share structure, and initial officers. The notary provides a certified copy required for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Approved corporate name reservation certificate
Draft Articles of Incorporation
Valid passport/cédula and corporate documents of incorporator(s)
Power of attorney if incorporation is executed by agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies a legal impediment, amend the draft and re-execute the public instrument. A fresh certified copy is issued after payment of additional notarial fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Registration with the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Sociedades Mercantiles
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the certified public instrument with the Public Registry together with the name reservation certificate and fee receipt. The Registry's corporate section reviews the instrument for legality, assigns a registration number and foja, and returns the certificate of inscription (Certificado de Inscripción). The corporate legal existence begins as of the inscription date.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Escritura Pública
Name reservation certificate
Registry fee payment receipt
Completed registry form (Solicitud de Inscripción)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a Nota de Error or requests additional documents, the attorney must submit the required correction within 30 working days. For stale notifications, refile under the registry's curing process or apply for ministerial review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration (RUC) and Corporate Governance Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; internal corporate governance records kept at the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the inscription certificate, register the company with DGI via the online tax platform to obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente). Simultaneously, hold the constitutive board meeting and execute the first board resolution adopting share allotment, registered office, and officer appointments; record the minutes in the corporate ledger and issue share certificates.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Inscripción from the Public Registry
Corporate details (name, date of inscription, registered office)
Valid ID and appointment evidence of legal representative
First board resolution and stock ledger entries
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For DGI queries, submit a corrected RUC form with supporting documents through the DGI helpdesk. Corporate book errors are corrected by a subsequent board resolution and rectification minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating License and Fire Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipalidad de Panamá – Dirección de Rentas Municipales / Panamá Emprende; Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Aviso de Operación as a non-industrial commercial service activity via Panamá Emprende or at the municipality's business desk, attaching the RUC and inscription certificate. For physical office premises, arrange a zoning and fire safety inspection by the municipal and fire authorities. Upon successful inspection and payment of the municipal business tax, the Aviso de Operación is issued; the fire safety certificate is issued separately by the Bomberos Department.
required_dossiers: RUC registration certificate
Certificado de Inscripción of the corporation
First board resolution and officer appointment
Lease or property title of the registered office
Fire safety plan and building occupancy information
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Aviso is rejected for zoning or regulatory reasons, submit a reconsideration with evidence of permitted digital/information use, or adjust the registered office address and resubmit. Fire inspection failures must be remediated and a reinspection scheduled.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial or manufacturing license required for ISIC 6391 financial news aggregation. The Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección General de Industrias y Comercio is the general licensing authority for commercial activities and may issue a commercial operation authorization if municipal zoning rules so require.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Operating License) under the Municipality of Panama; also referred to as Registro de Aviso de Operación Comercial.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE), Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – not listed as a Category I, II, or III activity; office-based information service has no industrial environmental footprint. No Environmental Impact Study or registration required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source emissions or industrial wastewater discharges. Office premises must comply with municipal sewage and solid waste disposition; electronic equipment disposal per Law 41 of 1998 environmental principles and MITRADEL hygiene regulations. If a server room is maintained, generators must meet Panama's national emissions limits and Ministry of Health air quality standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire prevention and safety certificate from Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load and building code clearance from the Dirección de Obras Municipales; occupational safety compliance with Executive Decree No. 238 of 1999 (general hygiene and occupational safety); and, if a server room is maintained, additional SINAPROC civil defense inspection for electrical and fire suppression systems.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); e-portal: SIREC (Sistema Informático de Recaudación), https://sirec.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned S.A. must first be incorporated before a Notary and registered in the Registro Público. The S.A. must file with the DGI through the SIREC portal (or via a licensed Contador Público Autorizado) an application for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente), submitting: certified copy of the Escritura Pública, corporate bylaws, resolution of appointment of directors and officers (Presidente, Secretario, Tesorero), resident agent (agente residente) certificate, notarized fiscal domicile, and the Aviso de Operación issued by the corresponding municipality. The DGI issues a provisional RUC and assigns fiscal attributes, followed by registration for ITBMS, INSS employer registration (if hiring), and municipal permit validation. Non-resident owners are permitted; a resident agent and a fiscal representative are mandatory.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - Territorial_Scope (Panama-source income only; foreign-source income is outside ITBMS and corporate income tax)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists; an S.A. is an opaque entity taxed under the territorial regime. Optional elections include: (i) acceptance into the ITBMS small taxpayer simplified regime (Régimen Especial Simplificado) where gross turnover is at or below B/. 36,000 per year; (ii) election of the 'sociedad extraterritorial' or tax-neutral holding vehicle treatment under Law 41 of 2007 for foreign-owned entities engaged in qualifying international operations; (iii) no hybrid mismatch election is available under Panama law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general exemption threshold for full registration; all persons engaged in commercial, industrial, or service activities must obtain a RUC and register for ITBMS. 'Pequeño contribuyente' simplified regime is available for gross taxable turnover up to B/. 36,000 per annum (B/. = USD at parity).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) via SIREC, phased per DGI Resolution No. 201-4295 and Law 134 of 2020: large taxpayers from 2022; all other RUC-holders from 2023. Issuers must integrate ERP/API with the DGI's REST/JSON endpoints, have each invoice or batch validated in real-time (transmisión en línea), affix a digital stamp (QR code/folio), and report monthly through the 'Declaración Mensual de ITBMS'. Offline contingency batches and fallback modes are permitted only with prior DGI authorization.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services are taxed at 0% ITBMS. Services, including financial newswire/API subscription feeds, qualify only if: (i) the recipient is a non-resident (no Panamanian tax identification); (ii) the service is effectively used or consumed outside Panama; (iii) the consideration is paid from a foreign bank account; and (iv) the supplier is registered with the DGI and maintains an exporter file. The exporter must claim the zero-rating in the monthly ITBMS return, include the customer's foreign tax ID/address, geolocation evidence of subscription use, and remittance records of foreign currency entering the Panamanian banking system.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación via SICE/Digitrac)
Bill of Lading (Conocimiento de Embarque) or Airway Bill / digital freight equivalent
Commercial Invoice and executed service contract (newswire/API subscription)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Remesa de Fondos) evidencing foreign-source payment
Proof of customer's non-resident status (exporter's retained KYC file)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the Código Fiscal and Law 134 of 2020, erroneous or fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger: reversal of input VAT credits, a 10% monthly recargo on the unremitted tax (capped definitively), statutory interest, and fines of 50% to 200% of the omitted ITBMS. Misrepresentation of export documentation, false bank remittance certificates, or failure to retain the beneficiary owner file may constitute tax fraud under Law 70 of 2019, punishable with imprisonment (up to 8 years) and disqualification from future export zero-rating. The DGI's post-audit unit cross-verifies customs declarations, SIREC e-invoice data, INSS employee records, and the favorable economics of the foreign payment before approving any export VAT refund (devolución del crédito fiscal).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: None. Panama operates a fully dollarized monetary system without a central bank; the US Dollar is legal tender and the Balboa circulates exclusively as paper currency at a 1:1 peg. The banking regulator is the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility with no capital account or current account restrictions. Profit remittance, dividend distribution, and repatriation of invested capital are free from prior authorization or mandatory conversion into local currency. The Balboa exists only as fractional currency units; all material financial flows are denominated in USD, eliminating foreign exchange conversion risk for USD-denominated operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender rules. Panama imposes zero export proceeds conversion requirements, no currency repatriation timelines, and no exchange control filings. Exporters may hold foreign currency in any account, domestic or offshore, without restriction.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for major international EMIs (e.g., Payoneer, Wise) only if the account is used for revenue collection and existing Panamanian bank references are available. Legal constraints: Foreign digital EMIs generally require corporate legalization (Apostille) and proof of beneficial ownership; many EMIs restrict high-risk sectors (news aggregators) or require a minimum operating history. Regulatory constraint: Panama's banking law (Decreto Ley 2 de 2008) applies to domestically licensed entities; offshore EMIs without an SBP license cannot offer local payment services, but cross-border electronic money services to Panamanian companies are not prohibited unless they involve deposit-taking.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person appearance generally mandatory for signatory directors and shareholders at the time of account activation at tier-1 commercial banks. Some banks permit remote opening through a Panamanian lawyer with a wet-signed notarized power of attorney and registered agent certification; however, the final approval step requires a video interview or physical visit to a local branch. Fully remote opening is not available for a Panama S.A. with this ISIC code without an established banking relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border news aggregator receiving subscription fees via API from multiple payment gateways (e.g., Stripe) without a single significant revenue source
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide audited financial statements for the first 6 months, detailed API contract ledger, independent verification of IP licensing, and a notarized beneficial ownership register (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales) confirming all principals are non-PEP natural persons. Include source of funds statements from the initial capital injection and stress-test the business model to show no dependency on cash-intensive or high-risk payouts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shareholder with a low-tax or offshore jurisdiction background (e.g., BVI, Nevis) that triggers FATCA/CRS enhanced scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide tax residence certificates and CRS declarations for every legal entity shareholder, plus corresponding shareholder register and power of attorney authenticated by Apostille. Include a legal opinion from a Panamanian counsel confirming the Panama S.A.'s sufficient economic substance under Ley 254 de 2019 and monthly payroll and office lease evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity with distributed counterparties in multiple LATAM jurisdictions, raising potential funds-laundering concern
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare a transaction-level event log with IP-based source information, API identification keys (publishable test keys and live keys), reconciliation reports from the payment gateways (Stripe/Wire) and a written procedure manual for anti-fraud screening. Engage a PPSAS (Public Certified Accountant) to issue an independent report demonstrating strict pass-through of subscription payments without mixing with operational funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bank’s internal classification of ISIC 6391 as a 'financial information service' may require a secretarial license or SBP regulatory comfort
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Secure a written legal opinion from a licensed Panamanian law firm confirming that the activity is non-financial (news syndication) under Resolución SBP 001-2019 and does not trigger the definition of a 'consolidated goods or services transaction' requiring authorization. Attach the business license (Aviso de Operación) and municipal permit to prove routine activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocol: route the initial equity injection from the ultimate parent owner’s bank account via SWIFT MT103 to the Panama S.A.'s USD-denominated operational account at a local licensed bank. Required purpose code for capital contribution under the IMF Balance of Payments Manual 6: 'Direct Investment – Equity capital' (code 5101) or 'Other capital than reserves for corporations' (code 5102). The supporting verification bundle must include: (i) the Panama S.A.'s registered capital clause (no minimum), (ii) corporate resolution approving the contribution, (iii) the shareholder ledger evidencing issuance of shares, (iv) notarized and apostilled board resolution if a non-resident director is signing, and (v) a banking reference from the remitting bank stating the basis of remittance. The bank will apply a standard compliance review of 48-72 hours before crediting, and the same-day availability is typical after approval.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements are (a) standard SWIFT MT103 for commercial invoice payments and vendor disbursements, and (b) Commercial Letters of Credit (issued under UCP600) for high-value purchases of dedicated software, servers, and data partnerships. For recurring subscription revenue from global clients, the primary rail is the Stripe payment gateway settlement to the bank account; ancillary rails include local Automated Clearing House (ACH) participation through commercial banks in Panama and direct debit cards (Visa/Mastercard) from US-based processors. All outbound wire transfers must include accurate purpose codes and beneficiary identifiers to avoid OFAC screening delays.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward contracts in USD vs major convertible currencies (EUR, GBP, CHF, JPY) with local licensed banks, permitted without regulatory restriction.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in currencies of regional counterparties (MXN, BRL, COP) for hedging importer payables, executed with global banks operating through an offshore branch.
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) between USD and EUR/CHF for medium-term balance-sheet hedging, subject to proper accounting disclosure under IFRS 9.
Butterfly spreads and simple FX options on USD/EUR for the newswire service's foreign-client invoicing exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual) — sworn declaration and payment for corporate good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama General Directorate of Revenue (DGI) via the E-Tax 8.0 platform, with payment confirmation into the National Treasury
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year; standard fee of USD 300 applies to authorized capital up to USD 10,000, with higher tier rates for authorized capital exceeding USD 10,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty equal to the greater of USD 50.00 or 10% of the annual fee, plus moratory default interest; sustained non-payment blocks issuance of Paz y Salvo tax clearance and eventually triggers suspension, administrative dissolution, and strike-off from the Public Registry

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficiaries Declaration (Declaración de Beneficiarios Finales / Form 800) — no-change or updated confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry, filed electronically through the E-Tax platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the January 2 through last business day of February window; supplementary update required within 30 calendar days after any equity transfer or change of control
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines ranging from USD 1,000 to USD 100,000 for failure, delay, or materially false beneficial-ownership disclosure; DGI may also suspend issuance of tax clearances and good-standing certifications

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Formulario 1287) covering Panama-source income, subject to the territorial taxation system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 following the December 31 fiscal year-end; if a different fiscal year is elected, within 3 months after the close of the adopted fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Surcharge of 10% of the tax due plus moratory default interest; criminal liability for willful non-filing or fraudulent under-declaration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit is required only for taxpayers with annual gross Panama-source revenue exceeding USD 3,000,000 and for licensed banks, insurers, trust companies, and securities issuers; a passive S.A. distributing syndicated-finance newswire content to foreign subscribers is not audit-required
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama (NIIF); small and medium-sized entities may apply IFRS for SMEs; books and legal ledgers must otherwise comply with the Panamanian Fiscal Code

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every Sociedad Anónima must submit the annual Final Beneficiaries Declaration during the February filing window even when shareholding is unchanged; equity transfers or control changes must be recorded in the corporate register and reported to DGI within 30 calendar days; the resident agent must maintain the underlying UBO register on-site for inspection
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Final Beneficiaries (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 – USD 600 per year depending on resident-law-firm tariffs and compliance support scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,000 for a certified audit of a low-volume S.A.; not incurred if the entity remains below the compulsory audit threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial regime: Panamanian-source income taxed at 15% on the first PAB 50,000 and 25% on the excess; foreign-source income (FSI) is excluded from the tax base, enabling an effective 0% rate on financial-newswire export revenue that is sourced outside Panama. Preferential regimes include the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime under Law 41 of 2007, the Ciudad del Saber incentives under Law 28 of 2003, and ITBMS zero-rating for exported digital services. No statutory minimum capital required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 1481 – Declaración Jurada de Renta (Personas Jurídicas); e-filed through the DGI portal (dgi.mef.gob.pa) using the taxpayer RUC and digital signature credentials.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; monthly advance income tax payments (anticipos) and monthly ITBMS declarations where the entity has Panamanian-source operational activity.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last business day of the third month following fiscal year-end; 31 March for calendar-year companies. The balance of tax due is paid with the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Ingresos Brutos de Fuente Panameña
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate gross revenue derived from Panamanian sources: domestic subscribers, Panamanian-domiciled clients, and services performed in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-owned S.A.: report only income from Panamanian-source activities; support with invoice registers and counterparty domicile records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate gross revenue from foreign sources, e.g., API subscription and syndicated newswire feed fees paid by non-resident subscribers and delivered abroad.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude this line from the Panamanian tax base under territoriality; attach a reconciliation schedule and preserve geolocation, subscriber contracts, and wire-transfer evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs and deductible expenses causally connected with the production of Panamanian-source taxable income, supported by invoices and accounting records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses allocable to exempt foreign-source revenue are not deductible; a prorated or direct-allocation method must be documented to avoid over-deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating losses carried forward and offset against current-year taxable income, limited to five years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain a chronological NOL schedule and reconcile with prior filings; the S.A. cannot carry losses against exempt foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after deductions and NOL offset; apply 15% to the first PAB 50,000 and 25% to the excess.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute using the graduated table; foreign-source income must never enter Box 5 even if it exceeds the threshold.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for monthly advance payments (anticipos) and third-party withholding taxes paid during the fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach monthly payment vouchers and withholding certificates; insufficient credits without evidence will be rejected by the DGI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 – Saldo a Favor o a Pagar
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax liability after credits, or refundable balance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay the balance by statutory deadline; refund claims are subject to DGI verification and documentary audit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing causes a 10% surcharge on the tax due plus 1% monthly interest on arrears from the original due date; failure to file also triggers DGI administrative fines of up to PAB 1,000, a 30% uplift on fiscal re-determination, denial of the Paz y Salvo tax clearance, and possible dissolution procedures for persistent non-compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Distributions from profits already subjected to Panamanian ISR: 10% dividend withholding. Distributions from profits that escaped ISR, including territorially exempt foreign-source revenue, attract a 15% dividend withholding rate. The S.A. must withhold upon dividend declaration and remit with the next monthly return.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To activate reduced DTA rates, the non-resident beneficial owner must be fiscally resident in a treaty state and deliver a current Certificate of Fiscal Residence (TRC) issued by the competent authority to the Panamanian withholding agent; the agent must retain the TRC, a beneficial-ownership declaration, and a statement confirming no Panamanian permanent establishment, and, where required, the DGI E-Tax treaty-relief application must be filed before the reduced rate is applied.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties, licence fees, and imported technical or digital services paid to non-residents in connection with Panamanian-source use: 12.5% statutory withholding on gross remittances. Interest paid to non-resident lenders: 6% statutory withholding generally, reduced to 0% where the lender is a foreign bank or supervised financial institution. DTA rates may further reduce statutory rates on production of a current TRC.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: PAB 250,000 in aggregate annual related-party transactions triggers mandatory filing of the sworn Anexo de Operaciones con Partes Relacionadas with the annual return; PAB 2,000,000 in aggregate related-party transactions creates an expectation of a full OECD-consistent Local File, Master File, and benchmarking study, particularly for intra-group data licensing and API procurement.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's economic substance framework, in force from fiscal year 2021, requires juridical persons carrying on relevant activities — including financing/leasing, headquarters, and distribution or service-centre functions — to evidence real presence when claiming territorial exemptions. A financial newswire operating an API syndication feed to non-residents is a mobile foreign-source-type activity: the S.A. must file the annual economic substance report and demonstrate (i) physical premises in Panama, (ii) qualified full-time employees, (iii) local management and direction, and (iv) operating expenditure proportionate to revenue. Failure converts the territorial exemption into an assessed commercial-activity tax base and triggers fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely characterizing Panamanian-source subscription fees as foreign-source income to produce a zero tax base; understating gross receipts by routing fees through non-resident payment processors without reconciliation; claiming deductions for expenses attributable to exempt foreign-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax fraud: fines of 100%–300% of the evaded tax and imprisonment of up to 5 years in aggravated cases; civil reassessment with a 30% uplift on the omitted base and 1% monthly interest; loss of the statute-of-limitations defense; embargo of bank accounts and denial of Paz y Salvo.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, legal representatives, and nominee directors who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the assessed tax, surcharges, and fines; courts may issue travel bans, prevent corporate dissolution, and order personal asset seizure to secure restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Sociedad Anónima as a letter-box entity: no office, payroll, or director meetings in Panama; all economic activity performed abroad while claiming territorial exemption for API subscription revenue; failing to file the annual economic substance report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic substance penalties of up to PAB 10,000 per fiscal period; loss of territorial exclusions; retroactive assessment of gross foreign-source revenue at the full 25% corporate rate; suspension of the RUC (tax ID) and judicial dissolution of the entity by the DGI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors authorizing the interposition of a shell may be civilly liable for clawed-back taxes and barred from incorporating new entities; criminal exposure arises when the shell is used for laundering or fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Funneling third-party Swift wire transfers through the financial-newswire subscription rail to disguise origin or true beneficiary; accepting fees from undisclosed principals; mixing subscription revenue with client funds in the absence of beneficial-ownership due diligence; using Stripe settlement for unrelated high-risk transfers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of Law 23 of 2015 (AML/CFT): administrative fines of up to USD 1,000,000 per breach imposed by the UAF; asset freezes; provisional closure of the RUC and bank accounts; predicate money-laundering offenses carry imprisonment of 5–10 years under the Criminal Code.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and designated compliance officers face imprisonment of up to 10 years, confiscation of assets, travel bans, and civil restitution claims; nominee directors cannot invoke ignorance where AML controls were absent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to withhold and remit the 10%/15% dividend tax, the 12.5% royalty or cross-border service withholding, or the monthly advance income tax payments on taxable Panamanian receipts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withholding-agent liability for 100% of the unremitted amount plus surcharges of up to 150% and monthly interest; DGI refusal to issue tax clearance for the S.A. and its directors; embargo of deposits and revocation of electronic filing privileges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the S.A. is insolvent, the DGI pierces the corporate veil and pursues controlling shareholders and signing directors personally for the withheld sums as de facto responsible parties; criminal conviction may add imprisonment terms.
